Roof Eidam & Maycock bought 3,672 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 21,536 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.65 million, up from 17,864 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Roof Eidam & Maycock who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $932.76B market cap company. The stock increased 3.92% or $6.94 $183.83. About 53.48M shares traded or 43.44% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
